comment: ANCHOR: MERGE_REFUSAL_NAMES_THE_PAIR_20261104 — a takeover refusal keeps its reason code (claim_takeover_chain_invalid) and gains a bounded detail: the two claim ids, their shared predecessor and the overlapping paths (at most five), so the refusal is actionable without re-deriving it. Every board is a synthetic tmp_path; no repo state, claim board, network, DB or broker is touched.
Registered so the gate file set stays complete: the shard runner executes gate files with pytest, and tests/test_ci_test_coverage_gate.py refuses a test file no gate lists (ci_self_guards / shard 7).
